Public site could not be read by available web tool. No accepted 8+/10 live site, supported revisions, real checkout/forms, three owner handoffs or unattended recovery proof.

biggestChange: Separate staging queue #1204 and designer fail-closed preflight #376 merged, removing major implementation blockers, but durable deployed isolation and accepted paid website delivery are still unverified.
improvements: #1204/#1219 merged: separate staging queue, staging prefix/signing key and fail-closed binding checks.
Stromation #376 merged: no-cost preflight, controller facts, ship gate and browser retry; merge train 45750231281 passed.
#1209/#1213 early access with confirmed-email path and runtime flag merged; audit integrity fixes through #1231 merged.
Release CI 45684464178 green after libzstd1 fix #1214; full gate on preceding SHA, not current main.
regressions: Staging deploy dropped isolation bindings and needed manual restoration per #1219; merged fix not verified by repeated deploy.
Optional fast release #1218/#1222 can bypass full gate and staging; no launch readiness credit for bypass.

Designer revisions remain refused; image scan #376 reports unresolved CVEs under changed scanner, so security acceptance is unproven.

assumptions: The website-builder asset/recovery defect is fixed and the merged repair release is deployed and repeatedly proven within roughly 30 days.
SelfOperate receives about 150–500 qualified prospects/visitors over 90 days.
Paid conversion is roughly 1–2% while the product remains supervised.
Supervised delivery capacity remains roughly 2–4 projects per month.
Roughly half to three-quarters of eligible delivered customers retain the $299/month ongoing SelfOperate service after any included period.

method: Nov 26: checked canonical commits, PR metadata and reported test/replay evidence, main workflow runs and job conclusions, current commit statuses and public-site access (unavailable).
